simple.meaning: דַּר (dar) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, a pearl (from its sheen as rapidly turned); by analogy, pearl-stone , i.e. mother-of-pearl or alabaster.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
